summary: Fix Pack 7 Wave C (Finances) fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases green covering expense-categories (seeded 12 defaults present, create + duplicate 400 + PATCH type toggle + DELETE), expenses CRUD (create with all new fields label/type/paid_at/supplier/receipt, filter by type/category/days/q, PATCH update, POST /receipt base64 upload, DELETE), /encaissements for days=7/30/90 returning {by_method, daily, total, count}, /profit-loss shape with revenue/cogs/gross_margin/gross_margin_pct/expenses_total/expenses_by_cat/net/net_margin_pct and math identities (gross_margin == revenue-cogs, net == gross_margin - expenses_total). Frontend: /console/finances loads with all 4 tabs (Dépenses, Encaissements, Compte de résultat, Catégories); Dépenses KPIs (kpi-total/fixe/variable/count) + filter chips (type/category/days/q) + Nouvelle dépense modal round-trip (label/category/type/amount/paid_at + save -> appears in table -> delete) OK; Encaissements KPIs (enc-total/count/avg/modes) + period chips 7/30/90 + Pie+Bar charts + mode table OK; P&L KPIs (pl-ca/mb/dep/net) + period chips 7/30/90/365 + waterfall + category pie OK; Catégories create -> toggle (Fixe<->Variable round-tripped) -> delete OK. Regression: /console, /console/statistiques, /console/clients, /console/depenses, /console/encaissements, /console/resultat all return 200.

minor.issue: Filter uses created_at timestamp instead of paid_at. The UI column displays paid_at, so a late-entered expense (paid_at=2 months ago, created_at=today) will match the 'last 30 days' filter yet show an old date. Consider switching the filter to paid_at (or whichever field P&L uses) for consistency.

issues: Mode de paiement <select> lacks a data-testid (manifest lists it as present but file shows none). Not blocking since the modal saves correctly.
Pre-existing hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from visual-editor instrumentation (dev-only noise, flagged in iteration_15 as well).

action_items: (Optional) Switch /api/expenses days filter from created_at to paid_at for consistency with how the UI displays and groups expenses.
(Optional) Add data-testid='expense-payment-method' to the Mode de paiement select in the ExpenseForm modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Finances.jsx (556 lines) keeps all 4 tabs in one file — reasonable size, but ExpenseForm could be extracted.
Backend P&L and Encaissements endpoints respond with clean serialized docs — no ObjectId leakage observed.
ExpenseIn Pydantic model correctly includes new fields (label, type, paid_at, receipt, supplier) with defaults.
POST /expense-categories correctly 400s on duplicate name and requires admin/manager role.
server.py now 4879 lines — monolith concern persists (previously flagged).

success_rate.frontend: 100% E2E for the 4 Finances tabs + regression on 6 previous routes
